items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Yeah, Jose Harris used to play the bass violin.

ctx.x: He played clarinet and sax. And Walter Nolan, I think you met him some time back, he played drum. Well he was a close, close friend to Chris Kelly. He played drums and I had a fellow, Lawrence Martin, he's a little carrier now. He played the banjo. And I forgot who was playing. Yeah, Jose Harris used to play the bass violin. Sixth person.
That was before you joined up with Morgan and Son Leger?
